Liverpool 4–1 Chelsea on 8 May: strong final home result three days after FA Cup final, but limited league stakes; the final and November league/cup victories are selected.
Opening Sunderland draw, Bolton win, Newcastle home win, Wolves wins and other league victories do not supply a comparably strong distinct turning point or landmark.

Bolton, Wigan, Newcastle, West Bromwich Albion, Fulham and final Swansea setbacks: the selected Tottenham defeat and QPR collapse represent different substantial problems without making every defeat a separate report.
